instrument: sustained synth/string pad with D drone (programmed backing; slow attack, no decay, identical repeats)
notes_ja: 録音の伴奏は、ゆっくり立ち上がって減衰しない持続音のパッド（シンセ／ストリングス系）です。キーボードではアタックの遅い音色を選び、コードが変わる所で静かに押さえ替えてレガートにつなぎます。イントロ（1〜11小節）はD3＋A3を伸ばし続け、8〜11小節目前半だけ低いD2を足します（8分音符のD-A-Dの刻みはバイオリンなので弾きません）。Aセクションも同じD3＋A3で、13・15・17小節後半だけG3-C4-G4（Csus2）に替え、D3とG4は次の小節へタイでつなぎます。19小節目後半からは左手で低音（D・AコードはA2、GコードはG2、31小節のBmはB2）、右手で上の和音を押さえると原曲に近くなります。B（22小節〜）は音量がかなり小さいので控えめに。
method: WHAT IS THERE: other.wav = violin + ONE sustained accompaniment instrument (pad). No guitar: no plucked attack/decay, no strum or pick transients that are not explained by the violin's bow changes (video frames: bow reversals at 2.72 s and 3.10 s coincide with the broadband transients) or by drum bleed; all accompaniment notes have slow attacks (100-150 ms, upper partials peak ~250 ms after onset), no decay across a half bar, a slow ~3.5 Hz chorus-like pitch wobble that is IDENTICAL in bars 13/15/17 (programmed backing), and the D3 drone is pitch-stable for whole bars -> synth/string pad. METHOD: violin f0 tracked with a CQT harmonic-sum Viterbi on the upper line (>=G#4; >=A#4 in B) and notched (k*f0 +-45 cents) -> work/guitar/accomp.wav; basic-pitch re-run on it (work/guitar/bp_accomp.json); CQT images of the residual for every section, half-bar sustained-level tables, bass-stem levels to reject bass bleed (A2/G2/B2/E3 in B are bleed and were excluded), and grid-aligned repeats (bars 12/14/16). INTRO 1-11: the D/A/D eighth-note figure is the VIOLIN itself (open D4 + A4/D5 on the A string with A3 string crossings; she is bowing from t=0.5 s). Backing = D3 drone (certain), A3 (likely; partly masked by the violin), plus a soft low D2 swell bars 8-11.1. D4 is not notated: it is dominated by the violin's open D string (drone harmonic). A 12-21: D3 pedal + A3; bars 13/15/17 second half G3-C4-G4 over the D3 pedal (= Csus2 with the C bass; loudest and certain), its G4 held one beat into bars 14/16; 18: G3+C4 over A bass (Am7), 19: G3 (A7sus4), 20: A3-D4, 21: G3-D4-G4. B 22-34: one 2-4-note voicing per chord change (D=D3-A3-D4, G=D3-G3-D4(-G4), Bm=D3-F#3-D4 / F#3-B3-D4-F#4 / B3-D4, Asus4=A3-D4-E4, 27: A3 then A3+E4), 15-20 dB quieter than in A and partly masked -> medium/low confidence; voicing details there are the least certain. OTHER: vocals.wav is violin bleed except a faint voice-like A3-D4-F#4 chord at 50.2-51.1 s (bar 34, possibly backing 'ah' vocals as the video ends; too short/faint to transcribe). A diffuse ~104 Hz rumble in bars 1-11 is non-musical noise. verification: CHANGES (evidence: per-eighth narrow-band levels and half-bar long-FFT peaks of other.wav, of its side channel (L-R) and of the full-mix side channel; CQT piano rolls work/verify_guitar/v2/final_*.png, lowz_*.png, wide_*.png): (1) ADDED THE LOW VOICE A2/G2/B2 in bars 19.8-34 that the transcription had dropped as 'bass bleed'. It is not bleed: the bass stem is mono (side/mid -44 dB) and the bass is absent from the side channel (side level at D2 changes -2.0 dB between strong and weak bass half-bars while the bass changes +44 dB; bass E2/E3 in 21 eighths 8-9 and 32 eighth 10 and bass F#2 in 29 eighths 10-11 leave no trace in the side), yet A2/G2/B2 are among the strongest low components of the side channel; A2 also sounds under D2 bass notes (bars 20, 22, 26, 30a, 33a, 34) and under the E2 of bar 27b, which bleed cannot do (D2 has no A2 partial), and other.wav carries almost no D2 bleed (+1.1 dB). Pattern: A2 on D and A chords (19 eighth 8 -> 20, 22, 24b, 26, 27, 30, 33, 34), G2 on G (21a, 23, 25, 29 - 29 weaker), B2 on Bm in bar 31 (releases ~eighth 9); no low note in 24a and 28 (side level there stays at the floor). It may be a separate low string/synth layer; written in this part because it is sustained, stereo-wide and moves with the pad's chord changes. (2) E3 added in 30b and 33b (Asus4 = A2-E3-A3-D4-E4): present in mono and side at the level of A3/E4; not a bass partial in the side (see 1). (3) D4 added to bar 27 (Asus4; side-channel D4 only 3-5 dB below the pad D4 of bar 26 and flat, not decaying). (4) Bar 24a Bm: B3 added (D3-F#3-B3-D4): B3 is among the strongest side/mono components at the chord change. (5) Bar 18: C4 kept for the whole bar (was cut at eighth 6): after the loud C chord it drops ~25 dB but then stays at the level of G3 through bar 18 in mono and side, unlike bars 14/16 where it fades out by eighth 6. (6) Bar 19: D3+G3 end at eighth 8 (G3 falls 10-15 dB at eighths 8-9) instead of holding to the barline; the low A2 starts there. (7) Ties added where the pad holds common tones across the barline: 7->8 (D3/A3 drone), 13b->14 and 15b->16 (D3 and the carried-over G4), 17b->18 (D3/G3/C4), 18->19; previously these were notated as re-attacks. (8) Chords: removed a duplicate 'D5' at bar 18 pos 0 (it coexisted with 'Am7' at the same position, left over from the bars 14/16 pattern). NOT CHANGED but noted: in B there is a melodic line an octave below the violin (27 eighths 7-11 F#4->E4 -> 28 D4; repeated B4 under the violin's repeated B5 in 29 and 32; 30 eighths 6-9 F#4) with timing of its own (leads the violin by ~0.2 s in bar 27, lags ~0.4 s in bar 30) - a guide melody in the backing or an octave double of the violin; not pad material, not transcribed. A sustained B4 in bar 27 and A4 in bar 22 (pad top voice vs violin double stops) remain unresolved. Confidence: 19 medium->low (release/entry detail, G2->A2 scoop around eighths 6-10 not notated), 26 low->medium, 29 medium->low, 33 low->medium. INSTRUMENT IDENTITY re-checked and CONFIRMED (no guitar): (a) 3-9 kHz onsets of other.wav in bars 11-34: 27 of 42 coincide (+-30 ms) with drums.wav onsets, the rest sit on kick positions (eighths 8/10 of bars 13/15/17) or violin note changes; no repeating strum pattern on the 12/8 grid; in the intro (no drums) they fall on eighths 2/3/6 and line up with bow reversals in the video (bar 3: bow turns at ~3.75-3.85 s and ~4.23 s, 30 fps frames); (b) attacks are slow: C4 of the C chord rises 10->90 % in 159/171/163 ms (bars 13/15/17, band-pass envelope) and is still -5.6..-6.6 dB at +0.5 s after the peak, then stops at the chord change - a plucked/strummed guitar would rise in <10 ms and decay continuously; (c) the linear spectrograms of other.wav and of the full mix show no strum striations other than drum hits. The transcriber's exclusion of D4 in bars 1-21 is also supported: D4 fluctuates like a bowed note (10-15 dB dips, envelope correlates with D5 +0.69 and A5 +0.35 = its own partials, anti-correlates with A4 -0.23 = string crossings) while D3 is smooth; in A it rises with every violin D5 (+0.52) and drops on C5 (-0.36), peaks at each downbeat and rings down ~20 dB in 0.5 s (open-string ring).
